dedupe_keys.name: vertical evacuation structures subjected to sequential earthquake and tsunami loadings

description: Vertical Evacuation Structures Subjected to Sequential Earthquake and Tsunami Loadings is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Dawn Lehman, University of Washington (washington.edu). In extreme events, such as major earthquakes or tsunamis, public safety is a primary concern. A major subduction zone earthquake could cause a large tsunami, which could render constructed infrastructure near the coastline, traditionally designed for only seismic loads, to be severely damaged and result in loss of life. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: evacuation structures, earthquake, tsunami. Published 2022-11-02. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the DesignSafe listing (publication licences offered are CC BY 4.0, ODC-By, CC0 and GPL; project page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
